newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stock market eyes currency, export data.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stock market eyes currency, export data.

text.p: All eyes would be on regional currencies as well as Singapore's June non-oil export data due for release around midday on Monday, dealers said.
"The market is expecting pretty supportive export figures. If it doesn't come up to expectations, you could see a sell-off," said a dealer with a local securities house.
According to a Reuters poll of economists, the June non-oil exports are expected to be around 6.3 percent higher than year-on-year in nominal terms.
Dealers said currency movements around the region will also be closely watched.
The Straits Times Industrials index ended 3.69 points up at 1,924.23 while Wall Street shed 130.31 points to 7,890.46.
